title: VIXEN_INSTANCING_DEMO=1 fails Prepare on the wave: upscaler provider absent from candidate set
body: Measured on the wave base f750d6e9 (vgoldens binary, product-identical) and on the vixwit assembly: VIXEN_INSTANCING_DEMO=1 exits 255 with 'Prepare failed: Compiled upscaler provider is absent from its candidate set'. The demo graph's early return in BuildRenderGraph never selects an upscaler provider, so the post-compile check added in 395e441b (VulkanGraphApplication.cpp ~line 334) throws. Consequence: textures1's owed instancing before/after capture cannot be taken; the demo also has no capture hook. Fix is to make the demo graph skip the provider check (or select a provider); not done here to keep the wave witness scoped.
